name: @test-cabinet/particle-runtime
description: Vendored, prebuilt copy of @test-cabinet/particle-runtime — the framework-agnostic particle simulator plus its 2D-canvas and three.js bindings — so this reference implementation installs and builds with a plain `npm ci` outside the monorepo. Byte-for-byte the library's compiled output (the one type-only `@test-cabinet/run-record` import, erased at build, is inlined in contract.d.ts); the game plays assets/effects/*.json muzzle flashes through its public `/three` API exactly as a real run does.
